title: Japan National Stadium
scope: The completed Japan National Stadium bowl, open-field roof ring, stepped timber-and-planted terraces and visible oval track and pitch.
limitations: The permanent stadium is modeled without temporary Olympic graphics and event fencing. The roof opening, terraces and bowl proportions follow the native map and public structural records.
Individual seats, small gallery elements and planting species are approximated at Earth-view scale.
Official GSI surveyed elevation controls the exterior concourse. The level athletics surface uses the documented design elevation. The original Mapzen sample is retained for comparison.
